args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (service unhealthy, error rate 18% across us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging before the production deploy. Follow-up: investigate the root cause in v2.3.1 and look into why it was promoted despite the staging failure.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. The SEV2 incident is open as INC-0001.

1. **Checked:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with 18% of requests returning errors.
2. **Picked the version:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production.
3. **Rolled back:** All three regions now run v2.3.0. Afterwards, health checks pass and the error rate has dropped to 0.2%.
4. **Opened the incident:** The SEV2 for checkout-api describes the failure, the rollback and the follow-ups. The request timed out, so before retrying I checked the incident list. The incident had been created, so I didn't send it again, and there's only one page and no duplicate.

The pre-release version of v2.3.1 also failed health checks in staging but was released to production anyway. I put that in the incident as a follow-up, alongside finding the root cause in v2.3.1.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
